summary: Florida Power & Light Co. (FPL) filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of $ Floating Rate Notes due June 1, 2076. The notes pay interest at Compounded SOFR minus 0.35%, are unsecured and unsubordinated, and rank equally with other unsecured debt. FPL may redeem from June 1, 2056; holders may require repayment from June 1, 2027 on specified dates. Proceeds go to general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
